summary: This flow diagram illustrates the process of identifying records through a database search related to AI agents. It begins with 730 records identified via queries and a recency filter, with duplicates removed, maintaining the same count. The screening process also involved 730 records, leading to the exclusion of 616 records. Subsequently, 114 full-text articles were assessed for eligibility, resulting in 64 studies included in the review. Additionally, 50 full-text articles were excluded for being irrelevant to the definition of an AI agent. The diagram effectively outlines the steps and decisions made throughout the identification and screening phases.
